hooks.name: On architecture change
hooks.description: When the agent saves an approved architecture file, generate or update code, tests and trace links for the changed elements only, then run the drift check.

action.prompt: An approved architecture file under architecture/ changed. Read .kiro/steering/architecture.md and the changed file. For each approved element whose block changed or is new, generate or update src/<element-id>.ts and test/<element-id>.test.ts. Do not touch unchanged elements. After writing each element's files, run `node mcp/update-trace.mjs <element-id>` to record it in trace.json -- never hand-write or hand-edit a row yourself, its hash has to come from that script's own hashElement(), not a guess. Then run `node mcp/check-drift.mjs` and fix anything it reports.
